IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_EXAMENES]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_EXAMENES]
	(
	 [ID_DIMEXAMENES] int,
	 [ID_EXAMEN_OLTP] bigint,
	 [NOMBRE_EXAMEN] nvarchar(4000),
	 [UNIDADMEDIDA] nvarchar(4000),
	 [VALORREFERENCIA] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_EXAMENES]
(ID_DIMEXAMENES 1, ID_EXAMEN_OLTP 2, NOMBRE_EXAMEN 3, UNIDADMEDIDA 4, VALORREFERENCIA 5)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_EXAMENES.parquet'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)

GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM [dbo].[DIM_EXAMENES]
GO
